rows.name: cnt-aligned-s1-p
rows.notes: fv-6 COMPARATOR ([VS1] p-twin): S1 rows with polarity = p. HONESTY: today the polarity flag is a LABEL — derive/build_vs_params always solve the n-type system (ptype 0) and the mirrored p-system (solve at (-Vg,-Vd), negate Id; [VS1] premise ii) is exercised only inside the inverter/cell twins (ptype 1). So this row derives to the SAME numbers as S1 and ties it on the scoring page until derive consumes polarity; it exists so the pair is visible as a pair. Unproven -> scores 0 until derived — POST {"action": "derive"}.
